settings.visualStyle: Grounded cinematic first-person WWII realism at Omaha Beach, 6 June 1944. Authentic U.S. Army infantry perspective, tactile sea spray, wet cloth, sand, smoke, fatigue and documentary-like natural light. Excitement comes from contrast, reveal, danger and human reaction rather than constant gunfire. Avoid FPS-game framing, heroic posing, modern objects and exaggerated action.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 scenes x 8 seconds. No spoken dialogue, no narrator, no intelligible speech. The POV remains Allied U.S. Army for the full episode. Nearby friendlies are U.S. infantry; German defenders appear only as distant opposing positions or clearly separated threat. Weapon visibility must vary naturally: ready only when danger requires it, lowered, slung, resting, partial-frame or off-frame during climbing, observation, recovery and exploration. Vary camera height and body state. Use cinematic reveal and scale without copying any identifiable film shot.
settings.customVisualStyle: Photorealistic first-person historical reenactment with human body weight, natural head motion, brief stillness, realistic focus shifts and tactile environmental detail. Camera composition is cinematic but movement remains physically believable.

movie.storyTitle: WWII Soldier POV EP01 — D-Day: Omaha Beach
movie.storySummary: A fictional composite U.S. infantry soldier experiences the opening Omaha Beach assault, from the landing craft and exposed surf to the bluff and first inland hedgerows, with quiet recovery and observation beats between moments of danger.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Make the viewer feel physically present as one U.S. infantry soldier on Omaha Beach. Use a cinematic rhythm: confinement, reveal, shock, movement, stillness, environmental observation, another burst of danger, recovery, climbing, scale reveal and exhausted inland movement. Do not show the rifle centered in every scene. Some scenes should have the weapon lowered, slung, resting nearby or absent from frame while the soldier touches wet steel, climbs with both hands, drinks, waits, scans or explores. Keep all nearby troops U.S. Army. German defenders, when visible, must remain clearly separated on opposing defensive positions. No dialogue or narration; use breathing, surf, gear, wind, distant battlefield audio and occasional close danger.

scenes.title: Inside the Landing Craft
scenes.description: A confined quiet-before-impact opening inside the landing craft.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier braces one hand on cold wet steel while the slung rifle bumps against his chest as the craft pitches.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person U.S. infantry view inside a packed landing craft, one wet glove pressed against steel, rifle mostly off-center and hanging by its sling, gray dawn, sea spray, soaked webbing, nervous American soldiers nearby.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low confined POV sways with the craft; brief focus on water beads running down the steel wall before lifting toward the ramp. Audio: diesel engine, hull vibration, waves, wet fabric, controlled breathing, distant naval guns. No speech.

scenes.title: The Beach Revealed
scenes.description: The ramp drops and the full beach suddenly opens in front of the viewer.
scenes.actionDescription: The ramp falls; the soldier pauses a fraction, then steps into cold surf.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view over the dropped ramp toward Omaha Beach, steel obstacles, surf, layered smoke and U.S. troops moving inland; German defensive fire originates only from distant elevated positions, not mixed with friendlies.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cinematic reveal from dark craft interior to bright gray beach, then one forward step into water. Audio suddenly opens from muffled engine to surf, metal ramp crash, wind, distant fire and sharp breathing.

scenes.title: Through the Surf
scenes.description: The soldier struggles through water with the rifle held high but not centered like a game view.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier wades toward shore, briefly staggering as a wave hits his knees.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person wet sleeves, one side of the M1 rifle above the water, U.S. soldiers dispersed ahead, surf foam and obstacles, smoke obscuring the bluffs.
scenes.videoPrompt: Uneven forward wading with a half-stumble and recovery. Audio: water inside clothing, heavy breathing, surf, gear straps, intermittent distant gunfire rather than nonstop shooting.

scenes.title: Cold Steel Cover
scenes.description: A crouched tactile scene behind a beach obstacle.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier lowers the rifle out of frame and steadies himself with both hands on a wet steel obstacle.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person crouched behind wet rusted steel, both muddy gloves visible on the obstacle, rifle not visible, water running over metal, pebbles and foam below, German threat only as distant flashes from the bluff.
scenes.videoPrompt: Camera drops low, hands touch cold steel, then a slow cautious peek around the edge. Audio: surf, metal vibration, breath, distant irregular bursts. No nearby explosion.

scenes.title: Eight Seconds of Breath
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier lies low behind the shingle, rifle resting beside him and mostly outside the frame, simply breathing.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person low view of wet stones, seawater dripping from a sleeve, trembling glove in foreground, rifle only partly visible at the far edge, blurred beach beyond smoke.
scenes.videoPrompt: Almost still shot. No firing nearby, no music. Audio foreground: exhausted breath, dripping water, stones shifting under elbow. Mid-ground surf. Background battle distant and muffled.

scenes.title: Read the Ground
scenes.description: The POV studies the beach route and nearby soldiers without moving forward yet.
scenes.actionDescription: From a kneeling position the soldier scans left to right, noticing U.S. troops using hand signals and a possible route toward the bluff.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person kneeling perspective lower than eye level, U.S. infantry only in nearby cover, wet uniforms and gear, one soldier pointing toward a gap; rifle slung and not prominent.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow left-to-right scan at kneeling height. Audio: boots on stones, web gear, surf, distant artillery, breathing. No speech.

scenes.title: Engineer Route
scenes.description: The soldier carefully explores a cleared passage near wire and disturbed sand.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV crouches and looks down at tape, footprints and disturbed sand before following an engineer's silent signal.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person downward inspection of wet sand, wire, boot prints, engineer hands and marker tape; weapon slung and off-frame, U.S. personnel only nearby.
scenes.videoPrompt: Start looking down at ground detail, then slowly rise to engineer hand signal. Audio: wire rattle, boots, sand, wind, breath, distant blasts.

scenes.title: Short Dash
scenes.description: A sudden movement beat after slower scenes.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier makes one short sprint across exposed ground to the bluff base.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person sprint with the rifle held low at the side rather than centered, boots slipping on wet sand, U.S. squadmates ahead, smoke layered across the beach.
scenes.videoPrompt: One fast human-weight sprint ending in a hard stop behind earth cover. Audio: boots, gear bounce, sharp breathing, brief nearby debris impact followed by muffled hearing for a moment.

scenes.title: Climb With Both Hands
scenes.description: The rifle is slung so both hands can climb the bluff.
scenes.actionDescription: Both hands grab wet roots and earth while the soldier climbs behind another American soldier.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person muddy hands on roots and damp soil, rifle entirely off-frame except for a brief sling edge, boots of a U.S. squadmate above, beach far below.
scenes.videoPrompt: Upward climbing POV with slips and pauses. Audio: glove on soil, roots snapping, breathing, distant surf and battle fading with elevation.

scenes.title: The Scale Below
scenes.description: A cinematic scale reveal at the top of the bluff.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier rises over the edge, steadies a hand on grass, then slowly turns back toward the beach.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person high-ground reveal of Omaha below through smoke, landing craft offshore, tiny friendly figures, muddy hand in foreground, no weapon visible.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rise from grass-level concealment into a wide reveal, hold two breaths, then slow look back. Audio: strong wind, far surf, distant battle, fabric flutter. No music.

scenes.title: Hedgerow Exploration
scenes.description: The soldier enters a dense inland hedgerow and explores a quieter rural space.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier walks slowly through a narrow hedge gap, pushing wet branches aside with one empty hand while the rifle remains slung.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hand pushing dew-covered leaves aside, mossy lane beyond, U.S. squadmate ahead, rifle not visible, ordinary farm textures contrasting with distant battle haze.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow doorway-like reveal through foliage into farm lane. Audio: leaves scraping gear, soft earth, birds briefly audible, distant artillery far behind.

scenes.title: Abandoned Farm Gate
scenes.description: A quiet human-scale observation of ordinary objects after the beach.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier pauses beside a wooden farm gate, touches wet wood and looks across an empty orchard before continuing.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person glove on rain-darkened wooden gate, wet grass, orchard, stone wall, no weapon in frame, U.S. troops only as distant friendly silhouettes moving along the lane.
scenes.videoPrompt: Static tactile close view of hand on gate, then slow lift toward orchard. Audio: wood creak, wind in leaves, breathing, birds, very distant battle.

scenes.title: Gear Check
scenes.description: A recovery scene where equipment is reorganized and the rifle is set down.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier kneels behind a stone wall, rests the rifle against it, tightens a wet strap and checks ammunition.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person kneeling view of hands adjusting web gear, M1 rifle visibly resting against the mossy wall instead of being held, damp sleeves, sand still embedded in glove seams.
scenes.videoPrompt: Mostly static gear-handling shot. Audio: leather and canvas creak, metal clip sound, slow breath, leaves, distant guns.

scenes.title: Beach Behind Us
scenes.description: A long reflective look back at the coast.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier leans slightly through a hedgerow gap and watches the distant shoreline.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view framed by leaves toward Omaha far below, landing craft tiny offshore, smoke thinning, one hand on stone wall, no weapon visible.
scenes.videoPrompt: Very slow lean and hold. Audio: wind in leaves, faint surf, one bird, distant artillery, tired breathing. No music.

scenes.title: Inland
scenes.description: The episode ends with a tired walk down a farm track.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier follows the U.S. squad inland at walking pace, rifle slung on the shoulder.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person tired walking view down a damp Normandy farm track between hedgerows, rifle sling edge only, U.S. soldiers ahead, boot prints and wet vegetation, battle haze behind.
scenes.videoPrompt: Steady fatigued walk with natural body sway. Audio: boots in damp soil, gear, leaves, breathing, battle fading behind. End without triumph.

characters.name: POV Soldier
characters.description: Anonymous fictional composite U.S. Army infantry soldier used as the viewer's first-person perspective; face generally not shown.
characters.mainOutfit: Historically plausible 1944 U.S. infantry field gear, M1 helmet, web equipment, M1 rifle

continuity.continuityRules: Keep U.S. uniform, helmet, web gear and rifle historically consistent. Wetness, mud, sand and fatigue accumulate naturally. Weapon state may vary between ready, lowered, slung, resting, partial-frame and off-frame according to the scene.

atmosphereAssets.title: Omaha Surf Line
atmosphereAssets.description: Gray rough surf, cold water, landing craft, steel obstacles, salt spray and smoke; nearby troops are U.S. infantry only.

atmosphereAssets.title: Omaha Beach and Bluff Base
atmosphereAssets.description: Wet tidal beach, shingle, wire, cleared routes, bluff base and layered distant German defensive threat physically separated from U.S. positions.

atmosphereAssets.title: Normandy Inland Hedgerows
atmosphereAssets.description: Dew-covered hedgerows, damp farm lanes, orchards, stone walls and ordinary rural detail with battlefield noise fading behind.
